{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Obama has made modernizing America's defense posture across the Asia-Pacific a top priority.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States remains committed to defending and deepening partnerships with Australia, Japan, New Zealand, the Philippines, South Korea, and Thailand.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will maintain a strong presence in Japan and on the Korean Peninsula to deter and defend against provocations by states like North Korea.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will enhance its presence in Southeast Asia and in Australia.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will expand networks of security cooperation with other emerging partners throughout the region to combat terrorism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will expand networks of security cooperation with other emerging partners throughout the region to counter proliferation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will expand networks of security cooperation with other emerging partners throughout the region to provide disaster relief.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will expand networks of security cooperation with other emerging partners throughout the region to fight piracy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will expand networks of security cooperation with other emerging partners throughout the region to ensure maritime security, including cooperation in the South China Sea.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will continue to invest in a long-term strategic partnership with India to support its ability to serve as a regional economic anchor.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will continue to invest in a long-term strategic partnership with India to support its ability to serve as a provider of security in the broader Indian Ocean region.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
